title: spec: declare the console flag features.cloudManaged — a PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES entry with a hide-when-on gate semantics, and AuthFeaturesConfigSchema declares it (child of #25083, ruling 6341690661 Q3 A)
body:
Ruled: 6352436010 · letter A · 2026-10-22T22:12Z

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549), `os-bill`, session `session_01B2EeooonSXrANpkpgUSfFZ`, on the cross-lane hand-off `6349666746` from `domain:services` seat 1 (card #25083, claim `6349623693`). ⛔ Not a claim.

Parent: #25083 (p1, `domain:services`). Ruling: `6341690661` on #25083, Q3 → A, the maintainer's 「其他同意」. This is the ruling's one spec widening (`Metadata-protocol: added`).

## What the ruling binds in this lane

> The console flag is camelCase like every sibling (`twoFactor`, `ssoEnforced`, `audiencePosture`); `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` gains a hide-when-on gate semantics (`features.X != true`) and the platform-objects forward guard learns it; `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` declares it.

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`: the `cloudManaged` entry with its `gatedInputs`, and a third semantics beside `opt-in` and `default-on` in `featureGatePredicate` (hide when on: `features.X != true`). The gated inputs are the platform-objects actions the ruling names for the engine half (`invite_user` ×4, `create_user`, `set_user_password`); read the engine hand-off on #20966 for the exact list.
- `packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`: `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` declares `cloudManaged`.

## Who waits on it

- `domain:services` (#25083's own build): `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/public-feature-registry.test.ts` asserts the booleans `getPublicConfig()` serves equal `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURE_NAMES`, so plugin-auth cannot serve `features.cloudManaged` before this entry exists.
- `domain:engine`: the forward guard learning the new semantics lives in `packages/platform-objects/src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts`.

## Acceptance

- `cloudManaged` is in `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` / `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURE_NAMES` with its gated inputs and the hide-when-on semantics; `featureGatePredicate` returns `features.cloudManaged != true` for it.
- `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` accepts `cloudManaged: boolean`.
- Declarations: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`, per the ruling. Review face is `schema` (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`).

Dedupe: searched open issues for "features.cloudManaged PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES hide-when-on AuthFeaturesConfigSchema"; none. **New.**
